faq: What does a mortgage broker do differently from a bank?
A bank offers its own loans. A broker like Coltrain compares programs and pricing from many wholesale lenders, then helps you pick the one that fits your goals.
How much do I need to put down on a home in Three Village?
It depends on the loan program, the price and your situation. Matt can lay out the down payment options you qualify for side by side.
Can I get a mortgage if I'm self-employed?
Yes. Besides traditional documentation, there are programs that use bank statements, profit-and-loss statements, 1099 income or assets to qualify.
What are typical closing costs on Long Island?
They vary with the price, the loan, title insurance and taxes, and homes at $1 million or more also have the New York mansion tax. Ask Matt for an estimate for your purchase.
